instruction.text: Who do you think King Edward depended on for support in order to govern?

end.text: At the time, it was impossible for kings to rule without the support of their earls. They were in charge of gathering the Anglo-Saxon armies, or fyrds, for the king.
end.sound: At the time, it was impossible for kings to rule without the support of their earls. They were in charge of gathering the Anglo-Saxon armies, or ferds, for the king.

atoms.b: One of the most powerful earls in England was Godwin, ((King ++Earl)) of Wessex.
Before Edward became king, Godwin had captured and ((++blinded high-fived)) Edward’s brother, who died from his injuries.
Edward and Godwin did not get along because of this. However, Edward still needed Godwin’s support when he became ((++king emperor)). He even married Godwin’s daughter, Edith.

instruction.text: In 1051, Edward exiled Godwin and his sons after an argument. What do you think this means?

feedback.end: Godwin and his sons were sent out of England and banned from returning. However, Godwin returned to England a year later with an army.

b: ++Edward banned them from returning to England.
Edward threw them a huge party.
Edward gave them lots of money.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in this conversation to find out what happened next.

atoms.b: King Edward, I am here with my sons and an army behind me to return to ((Spain ++England)) and take up my position again.
Godwin, I exiled you from England a ((++year century)) ago, and I will not allow you to return.
We earls refuse to fight against Godwin. If you don’t let him return to England, we will not support you as king, and your position will be ((++threatened protected)).
If you let me return, all the other earls will ((hate ++support)) you and help you gather a fyrd when needed.
atoms.sound: If you let me return, all the other earls will support you and help you gather a ferd when needed.

atoms.b: Fine. I will let you and your sons return to England, but you and the other ((dukes ++earls)) must support me.

feedback.finish: Edward was forced to allow Godwin to return to England. Godwin died in 1053 and his son, Harold Godwinson, became the new Earl of Wessex.
